# Logic Agency Inc.

> Fractional packaging and supply chain operations for scaling consumer brands. Monthly retainers starting at $2,500/month. No annual contracts.

Logic Agency is an outsourced packaging, supply chain, and operations team for brands selling into retail, B2B, and direct to consumer. Founded by Jordan Harper with 20+ years of execution experience across 15+ countries.

## What We Do

- Packaging sourcing, engineering, and production management
- Supply chain operations: supplier coordination, freight, QC, inventory
- Retail compliance: EDI, ASN, routing guides, chargebacks, scorecards
- Demand forecasting and inventory planning
- Manufacturer qualification and transition management
- Cost engineering: landed cost modeling, DIM optimization, material substitution

## Who We Serve

- Beauty, wellness, and personal care brands
- Consumer packaged goods (food, beverage, household)
- Consumer electronics, hardware, and wearable device brands
- Early-stage venture-backed companies through $20M+ revenue
- Brands transitioning from DTC to retail

## Pricing

- Advisory: $2,500-$3,000/month
- Active Management: $5,000-$7,000/month (most common)
- Embedded Operations: $10,000+/month
- All tiers month-to-month, no annual contract

## Case Studies

- [Epicutis](https://www.logicagencyinc.com/work/epicutis): Scaled from 3 to 21+ SKUs with 15% cost savings and 90-day rolling inventory plan
- [Audio Enhancement](https://www.logicagencyinc.com/work/audio-enhancement): Supplier transition with 100% pilot-run QC and zero customer disruption
- [Artilect](https://www.logicagencyinc.com/work/artilect): 20% packaging cost reduction and 95% material reduction
